'''Xander Mobus''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Mobus was born on July 8, 1992 in {{wp|Denton}}, {{wp|Texas}} and is a voice actor based in {{wp|Los Angeles}}. Mobus first worked on Pokémon voicing [[Steven Stone]] in [[Pokémon Masters EX]]. When Pokémon started being dubbed in Los Angeles, Mobus joined {{aniseries|PTS}} where he gained his most notable role of [[Goh]]'s father [[Walker]].
